title: Unlock PDF – Remove a PDF Password Online Free, No Upload
description: Remove the password from a PDF you can open, or lift printing and copying restrictions, in your browser. Free, and nothing is uploaded.
heading: Unlock PDF
subtitle: Take the password off a PDF you know the password for, or lift its printing and copying restrictions; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Remove a PDF password online when you know it and are tired of typing it: enter it once and the new copy opens without one. A PDF that opens freely but won't print or copy is unlocked without any password. The work is done by qpdf, a well-known PDF library, running in your browser; your file and password stay on your device. This tool does not guess or crack passwords.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file and your password are handled by your own browser and never sent to a server.

features.title: No more typing it
features.text: The copy opens with no password, in any reader.

features.title: Restrictions lifted
features.text: Printing, copying and changes are allowed again.

stepsTitle: How to remove a password from a PDF

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop the locked PDF on the page.

steps.title: Type the password
steps.text: Type the password that opens it; leave it empty if only printing or copying is locked.

steps.title: Unlock and download
steps.text: Click Unlock PDF and download the unlocked copy.

handles: PDFs with a password to open, when you type it.
PDFs that open freely but block printing, copying or changes: no password needed.
Every common PDF encryption: AES-256, AES-128 and RC4.
limits: The password to open is needed; this tool does not guess or crack passwords.
Use it only for files you're allowed to unlock.
A PDF that isn't protected is left as it is, with a message.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: Can it open a PDF if I don't know the password?
faq.answer: No. It needs the password to open. It does not guess or crack passwords.

faq.question: Why can't I print a PDF that opens without a password?
faq.answer: Its author restricted printing or copying. Unlock PDF lifts those restrictions with no password; use it only when you're allowed to.

faq.question: Does unlocking change the content?
faq.answer: No. Only the encryption is taken off; pages, text, pictures and form fields stay the same.

faq.question: Can I lock it again later?
Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.
